terms.comment: Anciently a peg or thole-pin; Morgan–Owens/Helfer extends it to an English dowel, i.e. a solid joining pin. A dowel is not the plastic insert for a screw in a wall. That object is usually a wall plug, wall anchor or expansion plug: an insert placed in a drilled hole so that a screw can grip masonry or another material.

sources: Lewis & Short: scalmus · Morgan–Owens: dowel
